findings.issue: No test script, runner, or devDependency — the app has no test infrastructure whatsoever
findings.suggestion: Add vitest (or node:test) plus a `test` script; the lib/ modules are plain ESM and testable without any Astro harness

findings.issue: pokemonRefsToSpecies — the highest-risk transformation (alternate-form exclusion, species dedupe, dex ordering) is unguarded
findings.suggestion: Unit-test with fixtures containing a Mega form (>10000) and two forms of the same species (e.g. deoxys-normal), asserting one Deoxys card linking to /pokemon/deoxys

findings.issue: Version-group defaulting (highest order), per-method grouping with min-level dedupe, and the METHOD_ORDER comparator with a -1→99 fallback are all untested
findings.suggestion: Extract grouping/selection into lib/moves.js and unit-test default game selection, ?game= override, table order (Level Up, Machine, Egg, Tutor, then alphabetical) and level-then-name sorting

findings.issue: Client-side sortable tables (numeric vs text, missing-last in both directions, aria-sort toggling) have no tests
findings.suggestion: A handful of in-app Playwright tests clicking Power/Level headers on a fixture move table would lock down the missing-value and aria-sort rules

findings.issue: URL-state parsing (page clamp, NaN/negative handling) and pagination slice bounds are untested
findings.suggestion: Unit-test pageParam handling (?page=abc, ?page=-1, ?page=999 with 2 results) and the slice((page-1)*48, page*48) math against a synthetic species list

findings.issue: fetchJson's in-memory promise cache, rejected-promise eviction and 404-vs-5xx error taxonomy are untested
findings.suggestion: Unit-test with a stubbed fetch: 404 throws status-tagged error, transient failure is retried after cache eviction, mapAll preserves input order

findings.issue: All pure formatters (humanize, dexNumber, latestEnglishFlavor, idFromUrl, orDash) untested
findings.suggestion: A 20-line table-driven test covering mr-mime→Mr Mime, #0025 padding, whitespace collapsing of \n/\f, and orDash(0)==='0'

findings.issue: Debounced filter fetch's stale-response race guard (seq counter) and pushState URL building are untested
findings.suggestion: An in-app Playwright test typing quickly and asserting the final DOM matches the last query; also assert the URL omits default params

findings.issue: The 404-vs-other-error pattern is duplicated across three routes (also abilities/[name].astro:30, pokemon/[name].astro:124) and untested
findings.suggestion: Test that an unknown name yields 404 + Not found h1, and that a non-404 API failure surfaces as 500 rather than the not-found page; consider extracting the try/catch into a shared helper

findings.issue: Excluded-type 404 branch (stellar/unknown/shadow) is a distinct not-found path with no test
findings.suggestion: Assert /types/stellar returns 404 while /types/fire returns the Fire page

summary: The app passes the provided Playwright acceptance suite but ships not a single test of its own — no runner, no script, no fixtures. The riskiest logic (species dedupe/alternate-form exclusion, moves grouping and ordering, pagination and URL state, client-side sorting, the fetch cache/concurrency pool) is entirely dependent on the external suite for protection. A modest investment in unit tests for lib/format.js, lib/data.js and lib/api.js plus a few in-app Playwright tests for the two client scripts would cover most of the regression surface.
